newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA'S LEU CLOSES SLIGHTLY DOWN, MONEY MKT UP.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA'S LEU CLOSES SLIGHTLY DOWN, MONEY MKT UP.

text.p: 1335 GMT - Romania's leu ended slightly weaker at about
7,400/500 to the dollar on Friday against opening quotes of
7,380/500 in a quiet interbank market, traders said.
* They said dollar demand was thin with many importers
staying on the sidelines due to the summer break period.
* Dealers did not expect major changes in the leu-dollar
* On the money market, one-week rates rose to around 41
percent from 39 percent in early trading due to some players
which run after leu funds to build their minimum required
* Traders expected money market rates to inch up next week
when the finance ministry offers 1.132 trillion lei in one-year
* Leu-dollar retail prices lingered at about 7,300/500.
